sentences.en: According to the weather forecast, which I checked this morning, it's going to rain heavily throughout the entire afternoon.
sentences.zh: 根據我今天早上查的天氣預報，整個下午都會下大雨。

sentences.en: The temperature has dropped significantly overnight, so make sure you wear a warm coat before heading out this morning.
sentences.zh: 溫度一夜之間明顯下降了，所以今早出門前確保穿上保暖的外套。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting it to be this humid today, which is making it feel much hotter than the actual temperature suggests.
sentences.zh: 我沒預料到今天會這麼潮濕，這讓體感溫度比實際溫度高很多。

sentences.en: The cherry blossoms should be in full bloom by next week, assuming the warm weather continues without any sudden cold snaps.
sentences.zh: 如果暖和的天氣持續下去沒有突然寒流，櫻花到下週應該會盛開。

sentences.en: We had to cancel our outdoor picnic because of the unexpected thunderstorm that rolled in from the west around noon.
sentences.zh: 我們不得不取消戶外野餐，因為中午左右從西邊來了一場突如其來的雷暴。

sentences.en: It's been unusually warm for November, with temperatures reaching nearly twenty-five degrees, which is more typical of early autumn.
sentences.zh: 對十一月來說異常溫暖，氣溫接近二十五度，這比較像初秋的典型天氣。

sentences.en: The fog this morning was so thick that I could barely see the road ahead while driving to work along the highway.
sentences.zh: 今天早上的霧濃到我在高速公路上開車去上班時幾乎看不到前方的路。

sentences.en: I love the way the city looks after a fresh snowfall, when everything is covered in a clean white blanket of snow.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡下完新雪後城市的樣子，一切都覆蓋著一層乾淨的白色雪毯。

sentences.en: The wind has been blowing fiercely all day, knocking over trash cans and making it nearly impossible to keep my umbrella open.
sentences.zh: 風一整天都吹得很猛烈，吹翻了垃圾桶，而且幾乎不可能撐住傘。

sentences.en: If the weather clears up by Saturday, we should take advantage of it and go hiking in the mountains as we originally planned.
sentences.zh: 如果週六天氣放晴，我們應該把握機會按照原計劃去山裡健行。

sentences.en: The heatwave that has been affecting our region for the past two weeks shows no sign of letting up anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 過去兩週影響我們這個地區的熱浪沒有任何要很快結束的跡象。

sentences.en: I always check the weather app before deciding what to wear, because the temperature can vary dramatically throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 我總是在決定穿什麼之前查看天氣 App，因為一天之中溫度可能變化很大。

sentences.en: The sunset yesterday was absolutely breathtaking, with brilliant shades of orange and pink spreading across the entire sky.
sentences.zh: 昨天的日落美得令人屏息，燦爛的橘色和粉紅色渲染了整片天空。

sentences.en: They're predicting a major snowstorm this weekend, so we should stock up on groceries and prepare for possible power outages.
sentences.zh: 他們預測這個週末有大暴雪，所以我們應該儲備食物並為可能的停電做準備。

sentences.en: The rainy season typically starts in June and lasts until September, during which time you should always carry an umbrella.
sentences.zh: 雨季通常六月開始持續到九月，在這段期間你應該隨時帶著雨傘。

sentences.en: Despite the cloudy skies this morning, the afternoon turned out to be surprisingly sunny and perfect for a walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 儘管今天早上天空多雲，下午竟出乎意料地晴朗，非常適合去公園散步。

sentences.en: The air quality has been terrible lately due to the wildfires burning in the nearby mountains, making outdoor exercise inadvisable.
sentences.zh: 由於附近山區的野火，空氣品質最近很糟糕，不建議在戶外運動。

sentences.en: I noticed the leaves are starting to change color, which means autumn is approaching and the cooler weather will soon follow.
sentences.zh: 我注意到樹葉開始變色了，這意味著秋天即將到來，涼爽的天氣很快就會跟著來。

sentences.en: It rained so heavily last night that several streets in our neighborhood were completely flooded by the time morning came.
sentences.zh: 昨晚雨下得太大了，到了早上我們社區好幾條街都完全淹水了。

sentences.en: The humidity is absolutely unbearable today, and even though I'm just sitting here, I can feel sweat running down my back.
sentences.zh: 今天的濕度真的令人受不了，即使我只是坐著，都能感覺到汗水沿著背流下來。

sentences.en: Spring is my favorite season because the weather is mild, the flowers are blooming, and everything feels fresh and full of life.
sentences.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節，因為天氣溫和、花朵盛開，一切都感覺清新且充滿生機。

sentences.en: The weather has been so unpredictable this week that I've had to bring both sunglasses and an umbrella every single day.
sentences.zh: 這週天氣太難以預測了，我每天都必須同時帶太陽眼鏡和雨傘。

sentences.en: If it weren't raining so hard right now, I would definitely go for a jog around the lake as I usually do on Sunday mornings.
sentences.zh: 如果現在沒下這麼大的雨，我一定會像平常週日早上一樣去湖邊慢跑。

sentences.en: The weatherman said there's a sixty percent chance of showers this afternoon, so you might want to take a rain jacket just in case.
sentences.zh: 氣象播報員說今天下午有百分之六十的機率下陣雨，所以你可能要帶件雨衣以防萬一。

sentences.en: Last winter was particularly harsh, with record-low temperatures that caused pipes to freeze in homes all across the northern region.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天特別嚴酷，創紀錄的低溫導致整個北部地區家裡的水管都凍住了。

sentences.en: The cool breeze coming from the ocean makes this coastal town a perfect place to escape the summer heat of the inland cities.
sentences.zh: 從海洋吹來的涼風使這個海邊小鎮成為逃離內陸城市夏日酷熱的完美去處。

sentences.en: I heard that a typhoon is forming in the Pacific, and it might reach our coastline within the next four to five days.
sentences.zh: 我聽說太平洋上正在形成一個颱風，可能在未來四到五天內到達我們的海岸線。

sentences.en: The roads are extremely icy this morning due to the freezing rain overnight, so please drive carefully on your way to work.
sentences.zh: 因為夜間的凍雨，今天早上路面結冰非常嚴重，所以上班路上請小心開車。

sentences.en: Even though the forecast predicted clear skies all week, dark clouds suddenly appeared and it started pouring without any warning.
sentences.zh: 即使天氣預報說整週都是晴天，烏雲突然出現，毫無預警地就開始傾盆大雨。

sentences.en: The temperature is expected to rise above thirty-five degrees this weekend, so make sure you stay hydrated and avoid prolonged sun exposure.
sentences.zh: 這個週末氣溫預計會升到三十五度以上，所以確保多喝水並避免長時間曝曬在太陽下。
